name: Vertical Stands (Indoor)
headline: Indoor Vertical Stands for Events and Lobbies
shortDescription: Self-standing indoor display stands for lobbies, showrooms, trade shows, and point-of-sale messages.
body: Indoor vertical stands hold printed inserts in a self-standing frame for clean presentation inside stores, lobbies, and events.
They can be built with round or square bases and support common poster-size inserts.
capabilities: Round base and square base display stands
Lobby, conference, and trade show use
